{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rieekan Historical Collection''' was an archive of documents kept and maintained by [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]. Among the documents collected in the archive were logs written by [[Jonox Forb]] and [[Vyn Rolado/Legends|Vyn Rolado]] during their time on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Rieekan allowed historians to inspect and reprint documents relating to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] presence on Hoth.
